messages:
nina: Quick postmortem follow-up from yesterday's outage: we had two simultaneous symptoms — runtime OOM on shard pool and persistent KV cache growth. I propose a combined "OOM + KV" section in the runtime playbook with separate quick hits for each.

raj: Agreed. The recurring pattern here seems to be long-running requests with large prompt prefixes + client-side retry storms. We should add a step to check per-request token counts asap.

lisa: Minimal checklist I'd like at top of runbook (one-liner for pages): 
- Run `kv-size-check && seq-dist && pod-restarts` then decide containment.

kevin: Can we make those commands copy-paste? I'll draft small helpers. Example quick commands I used: 
```
# show inference pods with OOM events (k8s events)
kubectl get events -n inference --field-selector reason=OOMKilled | tail -n 50

# query prometheus for 95p seq length for model
curl -sS 'http://prom.internal/api/v1/query?query=histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(requests_seq_len_bucket[5m])) by (le))' | jq .

# redis KV size per model key prefix (ssh to redis node)
ssh redis-node 'redis-cli --raw keys "cache:model:*" | wc -l'

# check autoscaler decisions for the pool (control-plane api)
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://control.internal/pools/shard-pool-3/autoscaler | jq .last_decision
```

nina: Nice. Proposed runbook flow (short): 
- Triage (0-8m): run copy-paste helpers, add tag `oom-kv` and set severity to P1 if >=2 pods OOMKilled.
- Contain (8-25m): scale pool down/up as needed, reduce max_batch_size env var on replica set, enable routing to low-memory variant.
- Investigate (25-90m): collect heap profile, KV key counts, recent model rollout diffs.
- Escalate (90m+): page eng-sre + model-owner + infra (if autoscaler flipped).

runbook-bot: Reminder: include checklist to toggle caching TTLs and a safe rollback command for model rollouts.

raj: Action items: 
- Action: nina -> draft combined OOM+KV section with the above commands + one-liner for pages. Due: 2026-04-12
- Action: kevin -> add helpers repo scripts `check-oom-kv.sh` + dry-run mode. Due: 2026-04-16
- Action: lisa -> update playbook PR and add section on autoscaler traps (who to page). Due: 2026-04-18
- Action: oncall -> run tabletop dry-run in staging once scripts exist. Due: 2026-04-20

lisa: I'll include a short subsection on 'common root causes' with examples: client batching mis-configured, quantization fallback to float kernel, and stale cache keys after model swaps.

kevin: I'll include `--explain` output in scripts that prints recommended next step (containment vs escalate) based on thresholds. Also plan to add a `--rollback-model` safe command that just sets traffic to previous model tag.

nina: One more operational note: add a line that if autoscaler shows back-to-back scale-downs despite errors, do not immediately scale to zero; instead pin min_replicas=1 and page infra. Learned that the hard scale-to-zero caused delayed restart ramps.

oncall: Acknowledged. Will try the script dry-run and confirm the one-liner is easy to remember.

runbook-bot: Created follow-up ticket: https://tracker.internal/INC-2026-9012 assigned to nina, kevin, lisa. It also scheduled a training slot in SRE sync.

nina: Thanks everyone. I'll open the PR with the runbook draft today and link this thread. Please review quickly so we can get the oncall one-liner in place.
